propositions: Read-only derivations over ticket event store must support metrics with clean event signatures (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked recovery) while explicitly excluding unavailable instrumentation (escalation, cross-agent handoff) until later tickets add them.

Hybrid data-access architecture uses compiled state via reduce_ticket() for terminal values (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) and raw event files for per-event/multi-occurrence metrics (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts), reusing existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX).

Metrics must handle date-range bucketing exactly via HLC filename timestamps, count both active and compaction-retired events, and distinguish zero-qualifying-range (returns None for Unavailable) from measured-zero-events (returns 0).

Raw event reading must filter STATUS events on open→in_progress and closed→open edges, collect distinct session identifiers, and measure multi-day transitions between closed/open states to calculate rework and reopen metrics.
Revert recovery must filter reverts by target_event_type (counting only STATUS and COMMITS targets, excluding COMMENT and LINK reverts) from the terminal compiled state reverts[] list.

Unit tests must verify distinct session deduplication, day-boundary rework windows, revert target-type filtering, empty-range Unavailable handling, and registry registration with source=structural and confidence=high.
